events.title: Section 10 Routine Vaccination Scheme gazetted
events.detail: Farmers may now vaccinate voluntarily under private vet supervision without waiting for the national rollout. Animals must be individually traceable and digitally recorded.

events.title: KwaZulu-Natal DMA formally lifted
events.detail: The KZN Disease Management Area restrictions have been rescinded. Movement controls will transition to a unified province-wide protocol replacing the localised DMA rules.
